inventory_method: Local PDF metadata and text-layer extraction; limited title-page/table-of-contents/heading review. No external sources used.

documents.classification_evidence: Title page identifies 'JAMA | Original Investigation' and 'A Vaping Cessation Text Message Program for Adolescent E-Cigarette Users: A Randomized Clinical Trial'; pages 2-8 contain Methods, results tables/figure, and Discussion.

scientific_audit_scope.rationale: Complete main article; results are on pages 4-7, including Tables 1-3 and participant-flow Figure.

documents.classification_evidence: Cover says 'Supplement 1: Study Protocol.' Its contents list Original Protocol, Background, Methods, Protection of Human Subjects, Data and Safety Monitoring Plan/Board, References, and Summary of Changes.

scientific_audit_scope.rationale: Protocol and administrative/ethics content are excluded from default scientific auditing. Open only for a specific cross-document comparison requested by a parent task.

documents.classification_evidence: Cover identifies 'Supplementary Online Content' and lists eAppendices A-D plus eTables 1-6. Pages 4-6 describe multiple imputation, inverse-probability retention weighting, and moderation analyses; pages 7-15 contain result-relevant eTables.

scientific_audit_scope.rationale: Contents page and statistical-method/result eAppendices/eTables are result-relevant. Pages 2-3 (program-detail appendix) and 16 (references) are excluded by default unless a specific comparison requires them.
